item.airwaves.audio_board.tooltip.summar: Made on the _Circuit Workbench_. Used for: _tape players_.
tooltip.airwaves.portable_radio.use: Right-click: on / off. Sneak + right-click: next station
item.airwaves.portable_radio.tooltip.con: When in your hotbar or off-hand
item.airwaves.portable_radio.tooltip.beh: Plays the station it is tuned to in your own ears, with static that grows with distance.
airwaves.ponder.tag.radio.description: Transmitters, receivers and everything that carries sound over the air
airwaves.ponder.transmitter_setup.text_7: Once running, it broadcasts whatever a cabled Tape Player plays
airwaves.ponder.radio_tower_drive.text_5: Cable a Tape Player to the cabinet to broadcast. A Redstone signal on the cabinet puts it on standby
airwaves.ponder.radio_basics.text_3: Radios stay quiet until their station plays something. Distance and bad weather add static
airwaves.ponder.dimensional_relay.text_8: A running relay keeps its own chunk loaded, so the link never drops. A Redstone signal switches it off, and lets the chunk unload
airwaves.ponder.tape_player.text_1: The Tape Player records music discs onto Tapes and plays them back
airwaves.ponder.tape_player.text_2: Right-click it with a Tape to load it, then right-click it empty-handed to open its screen
airwaves.ponder.tape_player.text_3: Put a music disc, vanilla or Etched, in the slot on the side and press Record. The disc plays while it is copied onto the Tape. A Tape holds up to 5 minutes
airwaves.ponder.tape_player.text_4: A vanilla disc stops the recording when it ends. For Etched discs, press Record again to stop. Swap discs while recording to make a mixtape
airwaves.ponder.tape_player.text_5: Wire it to a Transmitter, and whatever the Tape plays goes on air. Turn on Loop for a station that never stops
airwaves.ponder.tape_player.text_6: Without a Wire it just plays out loud
block.airwaves.tape_player.tooltip.summa: Records _music discs_ onto _Tapes_ and plays them. _Wire_ it to a transmitter to broadcast the tape. Turn on _Loop_ for a station that never stops.
block.airwaves.tape_player.tooltip.behav: Opens the player. Put a _vanilla or Etched disc_ in its disc slot and press _REC_ to dub it onto the tape.
block.airwaves.creative_transmitter.tool: Tape players cable to it like any transmitter.
